title: A codex secret learned in one scene and recalled in the next
watchFor: Rook already knows what Oria's case holds (seeded for the run) and names the control core to her face with Brask beside them. Since the player knows the secret and their words name it, it comes out in front of Brask: his summary should take it in (`heard` names `oria-senn.the-case`; the report shows "Took in someone's secret"), making a memory with the pointer. Between scenes the state is saved and reloaded. Two days later, with Oria absent, Brask should be able to talk about what Oria carries as someone who knows (his brief carries the learned secret), while Vex, who never learned it, gains no knowledge of it beyond what Rook says in front of her (acceptance 8).
turns: I set my glass down. "Oria, I opened your case. That's a Grid control core."
"Don't. Brask heard it too. What does the Grid want with it?"
"Brask, you know what a core like that runs, don't you?"
"Brask, you've been jumpy since the other night. Is it Oria's case?"
"Vex, has Oria said anything to you about what she's carrying?"
"Brask, what would the Grid do with a thing like that down here?"
